text_en: Jehoshaphat slept with his ancestors and was buried with his ancestors in the city of David; his son Jehoram succeeded him.
text_cn: 约沙法特与列祖同眠，与祖先一同葬在达味城；他的儿子约兰继位为王。

text_en: He had brothers, the sons of Jehoshaphat: Azariah, Jehiel, Zechariah, Azariah, Michael, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.
text_cn: 他的兄弟，约沙法特的儿子：哈匝黎雅、耶希耳、则加黎雅、阿匝黎雅、米加耳和舍法提雅，这些都是犹大王约沙法特的儿子，

text_en: Their father gave them many gifts, of silver, gold, and valuable possessions, together with fortified cities in Judah; but he gave the kingdom to Jehoram, because he was the firstborn.
text_cn: 他们的父亲将许多礼品，金银财宝，以及犹大的坚城分封了他们，却将王位赐给了约兰，因为他是长子。

text_en: When Jehoram had ascended the throne of his father and was established, he put all his brothers to the sword, and also some of the officials of Israel.
text_cn: 当约兰登上了他父亲的王位，巩固了自己的势力以后，就杀了他所有的兄弟，和几个以色列首领。

text_en: Jehoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; he reigned eight years in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 约兰即位时年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。

text_en: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as the house of Ahab had done; for the daughter of Ahab was his wife. He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord .
text_cn: 他走了以色列列王所走的道路，有如阿哈布家一样，因为他娶了阿哈布的女儿为妻，行了上主视为恶的事。

text_en: Yet the Lord would not destroy the house of David because of the covenant that he had made with David, and since he had promised to give a lamp to him and to his descendants forever.
text_cn: 但是，上主不愿消灭达味家室，因为曾与达味立过约，应许时常给他和他的子孙留下一盏明灯。

text_en: In his days Edom revolted against the rule of Judah and set up a king of their own.
text_cn: 约兰年间，厄东反叛，脱离了犹大的统治，自立为王。

text_en: Then Jehoram crossed over with his commanders and all his chariots. He set out by night and attacked the Edomites, who had surrounded him and his chariot commanders.
text_cn: 约兰率领自己的军长和所有的战车前去声讨；他夜间起来，冲出了包围他和战车队长的厄东人。

text_en: So Edom has been in revolt against the rule of Judah to this day. At that time Libnah also revolted against his rule, because he had forsaken the Lord , the God of his ancestors.
text_cn: 这样，厄东人脱离了犹大的统治，直到现在。里贝纳也同时叛变，脱离了犹大的统治，因为君王离弃了上主，他祖先的天主，

text_en: Moreover he made high places in the hill country of Judah, and led the inhabitants of Jerusalem into unfaithfulness, and made Judah go astray.
text_cn: 并且在犹大山上建立了高丘，使耶路撒冷的居民行淫，使犹大人背信。

text_en: A letter came to him from the prophet Elijah, saying: “Thus says the Lord , the God of your father David: Because you have not walked in the ways of your father Jehoshaphat or in the ways of King Asa of Judah,
text_cn: 有人给他送来厄里亚先知的一封信，信上说：“上主，你祖先达味的天主这样说：因为你没有走你父亲约沙法特的路，又没有走犹大王阿撒的路，

text_en: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have led Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem into unfaithfulness, as the house of Ahab led Israel into unfaithfulness, and because you also have killed your brothers, members of your father’s house, who were better than yourself,
text_cn: 反而走了以色列列王的路，引诱犹大和耶路撒冷的居民行淫，如同阿哈布家行淫一样；又因为你杀了你父亲家中那些比你好的兄弟，

text_en: see, the Lord will bring a great plague on your people, your children, your wives, and all your possessions,
text_cn: 上主必以巨大的灾祸打击你的百姓，你的妻子儿女，以及你所有的财产。

text_en: and you yourself will have a severe sickness with a disease of your bowels, until your bowels come out, day after day, because of the disease. ”
text_cn: 至于你，你必生一种极严厉的病，肠胃病，以至两年内，你的肠子都要流出来。”

text_en: The Lord aroused against Jehoram the anger of the Philistines and of the Arabs who are near the Ethiopians.
text_cn: 上主激起培肋舍特人和临近雇士的阿剌伯人的心，与约兰为敌。

text_en: They came up against Judah, invaded it, and carried away all the possessions they found that belonged to the king’s house, along with his sons and his wives, so that no son was left to him except Jehoahaz, his youngest son.
text_cn: 他们遂前来攻击犹大，侵入境内，掠去了王宫所有的财物，掳去了他的儿子妻妾；除他最小的儿子约阿哈次外， 没有给他留下一个儿子。

text_en: After all this the Lord struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
text_cn: 此后，上主以一种不能医治的肠胃病打击了约兰。

text_en: In course of time, at the end of two years, his bowels came out because of the disease, and he died in great agony. His people made no fire in his honor, like the fires made for his ancestors.
text_cn: 这病缠绵了一年多；二年末，当他的终期来到时，他的肠子因病都流了出来，他在极苦痛中死了。他的百姓没有为他举行焚香礼，如同为他的列祖所行的一样。

text_en: He was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; he reigned eight years in Jerusalem. He departed with no one’s regret. They buried him in the city of David, but not in the tombs of the kings.
text_cn: 他即位时年三十二岁，在耶路撒冷作王八年。他逝世后，无人表示悲哀。人将他葬于达味城，但没有葬在王陵内。
